# Pulse task #2785: EQ quality review cycle 2: independently retest Pro-Q 4 alignment and polish real mixing workflows

Operation: b82278095c8e0b470e4e96a5c6887bc3
Assignee: PORTALSURFER (Pulse #1, GitHub ID 41680373)

Second of the two EQ review -> focused fixes -> verification cycles requested 17 October 2026 to make Hex EQ really high quality and user friendly, aligning with Pro-Q 4. Schedule after #2784 cycle 1 has a concrete reviewed/fixed optimized candidate and findings handoff. Planning only; no implementation start, new executor or interruption of current Mac verification is requested.

Inputs: cycle1 #2784 comparison matrix, source/build provenance, fixed fixture/session, severity-ranked findings, fix PR revisions, native evidence and outstanding defects. Preserve canonical existing EQ issues #2654/#2657/#2729/#2730/#2731/#2736/#2737/#2738, shared widgets/theme, stable per-band automation identities and the existing 64-band product maximum with measured admission. User-accepted #2729 gestures and launcher spinner remain accepted. Prior Pro-Q3 and TDR Prism source context remains history; new reference is Pro-Q4 official docs https://www.fabfilter.com/help/pro-q , workflow https://www.fabfilter.com/help/pro-q/using/eqdisplay and analyzer https://www.fabfilter.com/help/pro-q/using/analyzer . Direct native comparison uses an available legitimate installed reference and records its actual version/settings; no purchase or invented listening result.

1. Independent review pass: reviewer did not implement the fixes it is accepting. Use the configured ordinary review role; Terra requires explicit task-specific user authorization. Reproduce the original cycle1 failures on retained baseline evidence, verify each repair on the exact new source and search nearby failure cases rather than only rerun happy paths. Audit reference matrix rows for unverified claims, misleading controls and accidental feature gaps. Record which Pro-Q4 interaction/workflow qualities are achieved, intentional differences and proposed future capabilities; do not claim complete feature or sonic parity from a short checklist.
2. Real mixing sessions: repeat cycle1 tasks, then a finite bass/kick correction, resonant percussion cleanup and broad tonal-shaping scenario using recorded fixture media and a disposable project. Compare task steps/time/misclicks against cycle1; examine whether core actions are discoverable without coaching, selections/readouts are unambiguous and exact edits are easy. Review node/response/spectrum contrast, gain versus analyzer scales, useful pre/post information and decay, control grouping, keyboard/focus/numeric entry, compact/expanded layouts and long values, hover stability and smooth redraw while audio runs. Include two/maximum admitted EQ instances, track/device switching, bypass/solo, rapid edits, Undo/Redo, automation and save/reopen. Judge usability improvement with recorded observations, not aesthetic assertions.
3. Recheck sound and performance after UI/behavior fixes: repeat predeclared response/calibration tolerances, extremes/rates/anti-phase/silence, supported automation/seek/loop/export and level-matched listening. Use fixed hardware/rate/buffer/workload; preserve raw callback/worker/GPU metrics and CPU/memory baselines. Confirm admitted maximum64-band workload and lifecycle/cancellation retain bounded storage and allocation-free callback behavior. Explicitly distinguish deterministic correctness, source tests, native responsiveness, physical deadline evidence and human listening.
4. Close the loop: duplicate-check every finding in Pulse, keep focused canonical fix PRs and original before/after evidence, repair selected remaining defects, then independently rerun affected regressions plus repository-required exact local checks. Changed behavior receives a new optimized source-bound build through the one serial Mac lane. Escalate architecture, signal semantics or product-feature decisions to the coordinator; do not fold an unbounded Pro-Q4 feature expansion into review repairs.

Exit: both cycles' selected high-priority correctness and core-workflow findings are fixed and independently verified on a named optimized native candidate; no unresolved P1 defect or required acceptance gap is hidden by Done status. A concise before/after quality report includes reference matrix, source/build and PR revisions, task observations, numeric/audio/performance evidence, finite user test list, and separately tracked deferred capabilities/remaining limitations. If a required item is missing, keep this cycle open with a precise next action. Optional human feedback is welcomed without inventing a universal merge gate. Local CI only; preserve user's running app and unsaved work; alpha backward compatibility/legacy migrations out of scope, current-format correctness required.
